title: Deckchair Care Welcome Café
venue: Gatley United Reformed Church, Elm Road, Gatley SK8 4LY
cost: Free; voluntary donations welcome
description: Deckchair Care's welcoming, dementia-friendly community café offers company, conversation and activities for older residents, carers and anyone who would enjoy some company. The listed sessions run 1pm–3pm. Dates are individually sourced; check with the organiser for any changes.

title: Memory Lane at Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church
venue: Cheadle Hulme Methodist Church, Ramillies Avenue, Cheadle Hulme SK8 7AL
cost: Free; advance discussion and registration required
description: A supportive group for people with dementia accompanied by their carers, with conversation, reminiscence and optional activities. This is not a walk-in event: contact the church office on 0161 485 1605 to discuss the group and registration before attending.

title: Hannah Louise live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
cost: Free for members; £5 non-members
description: Female vocalist Hannah Louise performs on Saturday evening. The venue’s current diary lists an 8.45pm start, free entry for members and £5 for non-members.

title: Dance Night at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
cost: £5 on the door
description: Sunday dance night with a DJ taking requests. The venue’s current events diary lists an 8pm start and £5 pay-on-the-door entry.

title: Lum Head nursery and reception open day
venue: Lum Head Primary School, Troutbeck Road, Gatley SK8 4RR
cost: Free; advance tour booking requested
description: Families considering nursery or reception places for September 2027 can look around Lum Head Primary School and meet staff. The school asks visitors to book a tour by calling 0161 428 7992 or emailing its school office.

seo.access: Public open day for families considering nursery or reception in September 2027. Book a place with the school before visiting.

title: Liam Gallagher / Oasis tribute night
venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
cost: Free for members; £5 non-members
description: Paul Hand performs a Liam Gallagher and Oasis tribute at the club, starting at 8.45pm. The venue's calendar says entry is free to members and £5 for non-members; check for changes before travelling.

title: Jack and the Beanstalk at Heald Green Theatre
venue: Heald Green Theatre, Motcombe Grove (off Styal Road), Heald Green SK8 3TW
cost: Tickets on sale; check live booking page for current price
description: Heald Green Theatre’s annual pantomime runs Monday 30 November to Sunday 6 December. Monday to Friday performances are at 7.30pm; Saturday and Sunday have 1.30pm and 6.30pm shows. Tickets are on sale through the theatre’s booking route.

title: Bramhall Early Festive Market
venue: Village Square, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 1AW
cost: Free entry; purchases extra
description: A free early festive market with local makers, handmade decorations, gifts and food stalls. Worker Bee Markets also advertises face painting and children's activities; purchases and optional extras cost extra.

title: Stockport's Spectacular Sunday
venue: Merseyway, Underbanks, Market Place and other Stockport town-centre locations
cost: Free; food, shopping and travel extra
description: More than 200 performers and over 50 free street shows, including a giant Snow Lion, circus and live music. A drummers' parade leads to a 4.45pm Christmas lights switch-on. Check the organiser's programme for locations and access before travelling.

title: Bramall Hall Decorated for Christmas: A Musical Celebration
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall, Stockport SK7 3NX
cost: Adults £7; concessions £5.50; under-16s free
description: Festive decorations inspired by Christmas music fill historic Bramall Hall. Suitable for all ages. Walk-up tickets from the Museum Visitor Centre; last entry 3.45pm. The organiser lists 11–15 November at 11am–4.30pm; check any subsequent dates separately.

title: Heald Green Christmas Market and Lights
venue: Car park behind 232–234 Finney Lane, Heald Green, SK8 3QA
cost: Free entry; purchases extra
description: Community Christmas market with stalls, entertainment and the local Christmas lights switch-on. Organised by Heald Green and Long Lane Ratepayers Association; check the organiser's programme closer to the day.

title: Bramall Hall decorated for Christmas: a musical celebration
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall SK7 3NX
cost: Adults £7, concessions £5.50, under-16s free
description: The Hall's festive decorations celebrate Christmas music. Walk-up tickets from the visitor centre; last entry 3.45pm. Check organiser details before travelling.

title: The Elf Trail at Bramall Hall
venue: Bramall Hall, Hall Road, Bramhall SK7 3NX
cost: £3 per participating child plus booking fee; accompanying adults pay standard Hall admission
description: A festive search for elves hidden around Bramall Hall, recommended for ages 3+. Each trail ticket is for one child, with a prize on completion. Last entry 3.45pm.

title: Rope at Players Theatre, Cheadle Hulme
venue: Players Theatre, Anfield Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5EX
cost: Ticketed; check current booking price
description: Patrick Hamilton's tense thriller. Monday to Friday performances begin at 7.45pm; Saturday 21 November is a 2.30pm matinee. The booking link gives individual performances and availability.

title: Disney's Frozen at Brookdale Youth Theatre
date_range: Production week 15–21 November; check individual performances
venue: Brookdale Club and Theatre, Bramhall SK7 3AB
cost: Ticketed; check current price and availability
description: Brookdale Youth Theatre presents the stage musical Frozen. The organiser confirms a 15–21 November run, but this listing does not assume there is a performance every day or supply unverified individual showtimes.

title: Autisk Play Zone: gaming, crafts and sensory play
venue: Adswood Young People's Centre, Neston Grove, Stockport SK3 8PH
cost: £10 per family or £5 per child
description: Autisk's family drop-in offers gaming, VR, arts, a sensory room and motor-skills play space, open to all ages and abilities. Check the organiser's latest access and session information.

title: Moya Cole Hospice Christmas Clearance Sale
venue: Moya Cole Hospice Distribution Centre, Unit A1, Bankfield Industrial Estate, Coronation Street, Reddish SK5 7SE
cost: Free entry; Christmas items priced 50p or less
description: A short Christmas warehouse clearance sale raising funds for local hospice care, with decorations, toys and bric-a-brac at 50p or less. Supplies may run out; check details before travelling.

title: Woodbank Winter Gathering
venue: Woodbank Community Food Hub, Woodbank Memorial Park, Offerton SK1 4JS
cost: Free entry; paid workshops and refreshments
description: A family-friendly community food-hub gathering with wreath making, gingerbread decorating and homemade gifts, supporting Woodbank Community Gardeners. Most activity is outdoors under cover; book wreath workshops beforehand.

title: Yuletide at Tatton Park: folklore and illuminated trail
venue: Tatton Park Gardens, Knutsford WA16 6QN; use Rostherne entrance WA16 6SG
cost: Adults £19.50–£23, children £11.50–£14; aged 2 and under free
description: A folklore-themed outdoor illuminated trail with storytelling and performance. Timed bookings essential; 90-minute suggested visit. Exact current prices and access information in our linked guide.

title: Ignite Fire Festival: six-zone BODY installation
venue: Rochdale Town Hall Square and Memorial Gardens, The Esplanade, Rochdale OL16 1AZ
cost: Free entry; travel, food and extras cost extra
description: A free three-evening fire-and-light trail from Walk the Plank with the six-zone BODY installation. Expect smoke, bright light and loud sound; Christmas lights switch-on Sunday 22 November around 5.30pm.

title: Superheroes and princesses at Bramhall Village Square
venue: The Village Square by M, Bramhall SK7 1AW
cost: Free entry and free family activities
description: Meet Spider-Man, Batman and a Disney Princess. Free activities include superhero training, workshops and face painting, with a princess singalong at 2pm. Organiser says 11am–3pm.

title: Manchester Coffee Festival 2026
date_range: Public sessions 21–22 November; Friday trade session only
venue: Bowlers Exhibition Centre, Longbridge Road, Trafford Park, Stretford M17 1SN
cost: Ticketed; check organiser's live ticket options (under-12s may claim a free accompanied pass)
description: Speciality coffee exhibitors, tasters, talks, competitions and DJs. Friday 20 November is trade only; the public sessions are Saturday and Sunday. Under-12s require an accompanying ticket-holding adult and the organiser's booking code.
